notes_md: Corrections to the research inputs (online_recording_modules.md / offline_subset.json / digest):

- The Stadium sync-load trio (`StadiumFileLoad`, `GrPsxIsValid`, `CustomZeroBuffer`) was INCLUDE[S] in the research; it is **OMIT** here. `StadiumFileLoad` replaces the async transformation read with `lbFile_8001668C`, which is instant only because `EXIFileLoad/TransferFile` serves it from Dolphin memory. Without EXI it is a blocking disc read mid-match.
- `Init Stage Data`, `Init Player Data` and `CSS KO Stars` are taken from the **Recording** section (they are built there in netplay.json), not from Online.
- `PauseCounter` stays OMIT: on every paused VS frame it writes through r13-0x49E4, which offline holds a stale CSS GObj pointer (memory-safety bug, not just a quirk).
- `ForceNoDiskCrash` (research: OPTIONAL) is OMIT by policy: it hides the disc-error / cover-open screen on real hardware.
- `Online/Core/Remember Who LRA Started.asm` is OMIT; the byte-identical General copy at 0x8016EA30 is kept.

- `Apply Delay to all In-Game Scenes` (Recommended, on by default in Slippi) is not EXI-free: `InitializeInGameDelay` asks the device for the delay (0xD5). Default here is delay 0 (group omitted). Option `delay=N` builds an EXI-free variant derived at build time from the pinned source (the request is replaced by a constant N, nothing else changes). Slippi 3.6.4's default offline delay is 2 (shown as 'Delay: 2f').
- `Optional:` codes are off by default in Slippi Dolphin (the netplay ini only enables General, Recording, Online, Normal Lag Reduction, Apply Delay, Lagless FoD).

- Five General 04 writes (`UnrestrictedCamera.bin`, 0x80452F54-0x80452F64) target `.bss` (`game_camera`); the baker must store them at runtime after BSS init (manifest `runtime_store_required`, audit W3).
- `Online/Static/IntToFloat.asm` (C2 into the extab slot 0x800055F4) is the only static-slot function the default set needs (called by the frozen-Stadium SSS code).

- **New layout constraint found by the audit:** five UCF 0.84 modules (`UCF Dashback`, `UCF SDI`, `UCF Shield Drop Extended`, `UCF Shield SDI`, `UCF Tumble`) load the instruction at 0x8006B460 (the hook of `UCF Pad Buffer + 1.0 Cardinals`, e.g. `lis r8,0x8007; addi r8,r8,-0x52F0; lwzu r9,0x750(r8)`), decode it as a relative branch and read the pad buffer that sits inside that C2 payload. So 0x8006B460 must also be a relative `b payload` with the payload layout preserved in writable memory, exactly like 0x801D457C (frozen Stadium) and 0x802F666C (delay). The digest only listed the latter two. The manifest lists all of them under `layout_constraints`.

Why the delay variant is generated, not hand-written: slippi-ssbm-asm is GPL-3.0 and its source is not copied into this repo. `lib/codeset.py:generate_delay_variant` derives `Offline/Generated/InitializeInGameDelayConst.asm` inside the out-of-tree work copy: it requires the two anchor lines (`li r3, CONST_SlippiCmdGetDelay` ... `lbz REG_DELAY_RESULT, 0x1(REG_IGDB_ADDR)`) exactly once, requires both `FN_EXITransferBuffer` calls inside that span and none outside, and replaces the span with `li REG_DELAY_RESULT, N`. The 0..15 clamp, the IGDB allocation, the pointer stored at payload+8 and the 'Delay: Nf' HUD text are unchanged. The build then checks that the C2 is still at 0x802F666C and that the first three payload words (`b CODE_START`, `blrl`, `.long 0x80000000`) equal the original's. Own source in `asm/` is only the two one-instruction boot files.

Profiles (`configs/profiles.json`, `build_codeset.sh --list`): `default`, `boot-css` (boot=css), `delay2` (delay=2), `slippi-parity` (delay=2 + all PARITY flags), `all-optional` (delay=2 + all OPTIONAL and PARITY flags; audit coverage). Ad-hoc: `--set boot=css --set delay=N --flag <flag>`. Flags: `widescreen`, `no-screen-shake`, `fd-freeze`, `center-hud`, `flash-red-lcancel`, `friendly-indicators` (group `optional-all`); `parity-8char`, `parity-erase-as-back`, `parity-confirm-a`, `parity-css-bcancel-sfx`, `parity-parse-numbers`, `parity-skip-stage-number` (group `parity`).

Audit waivers (`configs/audit_allow.json`): two PARITY modules branch into hooks of omitted modules (`PreventColorResetLastChar` -> 0x80260B90, `OnConfirmButtonAPress` -> 0x8023CC14). Both omitted hooks run their original instruction `li r0,0` offline, which is the retail word at those addresses, so they are waived with the evidence recorded there.

Own additive modules (`extra_modules`, flag-gated, not netplay modules so not in the tables below): `rules-after-load` (`asm/Rules/RulesAfterLoad.asm`, C2 0x8015FAE4, in `default`) and `card-silent-create` (`asm/Card/SilentCreate*.asm`, six 04 words at 0x801AF3A0, 0x801AF3A8, 0x801AF3AC, 0x801AF3B0, 0x801AF3B8, 0x801AFAD4; profile `cardloader` = default + it, for the stage-1 card loader `offline/cardloader/ms_stage1_silent.mgc`): the memory-card scene creates a missing save on a healthy card with free space without the 'Create Game Data?' question; the build checks each target still holds its retail word. Training (docs/design/OWN_TRAINING.md, profile `training1` = default + `flash-red-lcancel` + both): `flash-white-lcancel` (`asm/Training/LCancelFlashWhite.asm`, C2 0x8008D6EC: white flash on a successful L-cancel, writes only Melee's colour overlay fp->x488, off in the online in-game scene) and `hitbox-view-training` (`asm/Training/HitboxView.asm`, C2 0x800805F0: Melee's own collision debug draw in Training Mode only, register-only, no memory write); the build checks both hooks still hold their retail words. Tech card (OWN_TRAINING.md 1d, profile `training2` = training1 + `tech-card`): `asm/Training/TechCardCount.asm` (C2 0x800693AC, entry of Fighter_ChangeMotionState: read-only counts per port in a 72-byte block inside its own payload), `TechCardDraw.asm` (C2 0x80175D14: three lines per human player in the results screen's portrait boxes) and `TechCardResults.asm` (C2 0x801A5C14: Melee's results screen after a finished Vs match instead of Salty Runback's straight return to the CSS); the build checks all three retail words.
